cards.name: hero
cards.question: EXIF Remover
cards.answer: Remove EXIF Data & Location From Photos
cards.qualifier: See exactly what your photos reveal (location, camera, date taken) and remove it in one tap. JPEG and PNG files are cleaned without touching the image, and nothing leaves your device.

groups.label: What it reads
groups.text: For every photo, a table lists what the file contains:

groups.label: Your photos stay on your device
groups.text: Photos are read and cleaned on your device.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to remove EXIF data from a photo

steps.title: Add your photos
steps.text: Tap Choose photos or drop them here, or drag files onto the box.

steps.title: Check what's inside
steps.text: Look at the summary line and the red location warnings first.

cards.name: lossless-cleaning-and-when
cards.title: Lossless cleaning and when a photo is re-saved

groups.label: JPEG and PNG: cleaned losslessly
groups.text: JPEG and PNG files are cleaned without re-compressing.

groups.label: WebP and HEIC are re-saved as JPEG
groups.text: The tool lists metadata for JPEG, PNG and WebP files.

groups.label: Extras after the image are removed
groups.text: Some phone JPEGs carry extra data after the main picture.

cards.name: key-point
cards.kicker: How to stop your camera adding location
cards.quote: Cleaning photos one by one works, but it's easier if new photos never get a location in the first place.
